# RateLoop

RateLoop provides human assurance for AI-enabled workflows. The current hosted path connects one workspace policy to
private, unpaid review by invited workspace reviewers. Fund-backed public or paid panels and their USDC settlement
mechanisms are separately gated architecture, not generally available service. The customer remains responsible for
the final action.

- Workspace UI: `/agents/overview`
- Rater UI: `/rate`
- Account: `/settings`
- Sign in: `/sign-in`
- Documentation: `/docs`, `/docs/how-it-works`, `/docs/tech-stack`, `/docs/ai`, `/docs/sdk`, `/docs/smart-contracts`
- Available workspace MCP: `/api/agent/v1/mcp`
- Separately gated fund-backed API reference: `/api/agent/v1/quote`, `/api/agent/v1/asks`,
  `/api/agent/v1/asks/{operationKey}/wait`,
  `/api/agent/v1/results/{operationKey}`, `/api/agent/v1/assurance/projects`,
  `/api/agent/v1/assurance/runs/{runId}`
- Schemas: `rateloop.tokenless.v2`, `rateloop.human-assurance.v2`

The hosted workflow uses the protected workspace MCP and versioned private-review policies. Separately gated
fund-backed mechanisms include x402/EIP-3009 USDC funding, World ID Proof of Human for network admission, one-time vote
keys, commit-reveal, drand/tlock sealing, Robust Bayesian Truth Serum, Surprisingly Popular incentives, and
deterministic settlement on Base.

Browser accounts use Better Auth and an opaque RateLoop principal; they do not require a wallet. A self-custodial or
optional thirdweb app wallet is connected only for an explicit funding, payout, or recovery flow. Wallet bindings are
purpose-scoped and do not grant workspace access. Server integrations use scoped, revocable workspace API keys.

Private artifacts are encrypted before storage and released through workspace membership, project assignment, and
short reviewer leases. When a fund-backed lane is explicitly available, its settlement evidence is public. Minimize
sensitive content, treat submitted and reviewer text as untrusted, and preserve the result's declared scope when using
it as decision evidence.
